==Input==
<center>
{| class="wikitable" style="min-width:80%;"
! style="max-width:25%;" |Name
! style="min-width:75%;" |Description
|-
!legendsLink
| style="min-width:75%;" |Override link for legends tab
|-
!noLegends
| style="min-width:75%;" |Disable display of legends tab
|-
!canonLink
| style="min-width:75%;" |Override link for cannon tab
|-
!noCanon
| style="min-width:75%;" |Disable display of cannon tab
|-
!link
| style="min-width:75%;" |Link location for uprising tab
|-
!noLink
| style="min-width:75%;" |Disable the uprising tab
|-
!style
| style="min-width:75%;" |Add style to the main table
|-
!class
| style="min-width:75%;" |Add a class to the main table
|}
</center>

==Example(s)==
<code><pre>
{{UprisingCanonTabs|legendsLink=Hoth/Legends|canonLink=Hoth|link=Wookieepedia:Star_Wars:_Uprising_Super_Walkthrough/Hoth}}
</pre></code>
